witnesses.code:
axes = data["axes"]
index = data["index"]
scale = data["scale"]
translation = data["translation"]
physical = {axis: index[axis] * scale[axis] + translation[axis] for axis in axes}
expected = data["expected_physical"]
assert all(abs(physical[a] - expected[a]) < 1e-12 for a in axes)
recovered = {axis: (physical[axis] - translation[axis]) / scale[axis] for axis in axes}
assert all(abs(recovered[a] - index[a]) < 1e-12 for a in axes)
print({"physical": physical, "recovered_index": recovered, "round_trip": True})
witnesses.expected_behavior: Apply one scale then translation per named axis; inverse should recover the input index for nonzero scales. The expected values are directly calculated for this explicitly declared test vector, consistent with the OME-NGFF 0.4 scale/translation ordering described in S1 §3.3.
witnesses.scope_limits: Isolated arithmetic only. Does not establish OME-NGFF parsing, reader metadata interpretation, napari rendering, app persistence, arbitrary affine behavior, or full application correctness.

witnesses.check: Use a synthetic asymmetric multiaxis image with non-square scale, nonzero origin, axis permutation and flip; save/reopen points, polygon and mask and compare stored, displayed and physical coordinates.
witnesses.expected_behavior: Each annotation returns to the declared source index and physical coordinate, including after view change; raw metadata is preserved.
witnesses.limits: Requires prototype reader, renderer and project serialization; W1 is not a substitute.

witnesses.check: Run representative 3 GB source on 16 GB workstation; trace block requests, aggregate app/reader RSS, cache occupancy, progress, source hash, and cancellation at a delayed read.
witnesses.expected_behavior: No source-sized allocation, cache <=512 MiB, proposed aggregate RSS <=6 GiB, no source hash change, visible progress, cancellation once current decode call returns.
witnesses.limits: Must be repeated per reader/format variant; API region calls do not prove bounded codec allocations.

witnesses.check: Compare display-only changes and one recorded geometric resampling against source and derived hashes; inspect operation and affine metadata.
witnesses.expected_behavior: Display edits leave original bytes unchanged; resampling creates a derived resource and auditable operation; annotation migration is explicit.

witnesses.check: Inject termination during import, DB transaction, asset staging, export and snapshot publication; reopen local and shared-storage snapshots.
witnesses.expected_behavior: Last verified project remains usable; incomplete outputs never appear complete; actual shared storage meets tested publish/reopen semantics.
witnesses.limits: SQLite docs do not guarantee the group's filesystem behavior.

witnesses.check: Relocate a reference-backed project to another workstation; verify full SHA-256/series before and after relocation; test mismatch and multi-file input.
witnesses.expected_behavior: Verified source rebind is recorded; mismatch preserves project and blocks source-dependent export pending explicit confirmation.
witnesses.limits: Hash duration and real instrument multi-file behavior require measurement.

witnesses.check: Export point/polygon/mask table, overlay and small derived crop; compare output to project and re-import in a clean project.
witnesses.expected_behavior: Coordinate order/origin/scope, channel/time/slice, transform, sample conversion and overlap losses are reported; source unchanged.
witnesses.limits: Format interoperability varies; no external app round-trip is claimed until tested.

witnesses.check: Keyboard-only task completion, focus/labels, contrast and non-color status for import failure, unresolved metadata, annotation, undo/redo and export.
witnesses.expected_behavior: Core workflow is operable without a pointer, and errors/metadata remain legible and explicitly labeled.
witnesses.limits: Requires accessibility review with target researchers; not tested in this stage.
